# Hiroshima University Home

> A university resource hub featuring technical documentation, software guides, and collaborative wiki-based knowledge management.

This site serves as a central repository for Hiroshima University resources, utilizing PukiWiki for collaborative documentation and hosting technical guides for research and development tools. The site emphasizes open-source software documentation and installation guides for various platforms.

## Key Topics

- PukiWiki
- Levmar optimization library
- Mac installation
- Technical documentation
- WikiWikiWeb
- GPL v2 licensing
- Software setup guides
- Optimization algorithms
- Cross-platform development
- Hiroshima University

## Software Installation & Setup Guides

- [Levmar on Mac](https://home.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/~higaki/wiki/index.php?Levmar+on+Mac): Guide for installing Levmar optimization library on Mac systems
